rationale: Reorganizes Space settings into four responsive shared sections and introduces independently inherited font bases and device battery policy, with explicit compatibility for coupled opening visibility and background colour.

summary.ru: Настройки пространства получили четыре раздела, независимые размеры названий и показателей, наследование заряда и понятные переходы к общим параметрам.
summary.en: Space settings gain four sections, independent name and metric sizes, inherited battery policy and direct links to General settings.
